settings.headline:
A place that belongs
to everyone.
settings.copy: The Commons is where the neighborhood gathers — to learn, to create, to share a meal, and to look out for each other. Open every day, free to walk in, and built around the people who live here.

trust_list.text: Free & open to all, every day
A kitchen that never turns anyone away
Run with the community, for the community

settings.title: Programs for every
settings.intro: From after-school homework clubs to evening English classes to a shared garden, there's a reason for every neighbor to walk through our doors.

design.title: After-school homework club
design.text: A quiet, supported space with tutors and a hot snack every school day. Homework gets done, friendships get made.

design.title: Youth arts & music
design.text: Free lessons in painting, theatre, and instruments, with a showcase night each season for families and neighbors.

build.title: English & citizenship classes
build.text: Taught by volunteer instructors, with childcare on site so parents can actually focus and show up.

build.title: Senior social & wellness
build.text: Morning movement, tea circles, tech help, and a warm lunch — a daily reason to get out and connect.

launch.title: Community kitchen
launch.text: A professional kitchen and dining hall that turns no one away. Pay-what-you-can meals, plus free space for neighbor-hosted suppers.

launch.title: Rooms & garden
launch.text: Meeting rooms, a makerspace, and a shared garden available free or low-cost to local groups and residents.

settings.title: Three ways in,

steps.title: Walk in the door
steps.text: No registration, no membership card. Come for a meal, a class, or just to see the space. Someone will show you around.

steps.title: Join a program
steps.text: Pick from the weekly schedule — most are free, all are open. If you don't see what you need, tell us and we'll help find it.

steps.title: Give back
steps.text: Volunteer an evening, teach a skill, or donate to the kitchen fund. The building runs on the people who show up.

settings.note: Every program is free or pay-what-you-can. Nobody is ever turned away for what they can't afford.

events.title: The doors open
events.text: A donated church hall becomes a meeting place for the neighborhood's new families.

events.title: The kitchen begins
events.text: Volunteers start serving a weekly community supper that has run ever since.

events.title: The center expands
events.text: A new wing adds classrooms, a library, and the garden that still feeds the kitchen today.

events.title: Youth programming grows
events.text: After-school and arts programs double, supported by a neighborhood-wide fundraising drive.

events.title: Built by the block
events.text: Over 900 volunteers and 38,000 neighbors keep the doors open and the welcome warm.

settings.title: Keep the welcome
settings.quote: What a neighborhood is, in the end, is the people who show up for each other.

settings.title: The door is always open
settings.intro: Drop by any day, or send us a note. If you'd like to volunteer, teach, or host an event, we'd love to hear from you.

settings.blurb: A neighborhood community center where people gather, learn, create, and look out for one another — open to all, every day.
